detailed_descriptions.en: Unpossess 2 is a 1–4 player co-op exorcism simulation game set in the late 1900s. Inspired by iconic horror movies, you will play as an exorcist tasked with resolving cases of demonic possession. Whether playing alone or alongside other exorcists, you must confront and exorcise humans from demons. You will have to cleanse the haunted location, gather evidence, and perform an exorcism to free the possessed from demonic influence. You must carefully manage the health and sanity of yourself and your fellow exorcists. Developed using Unreal Engine 5, Unpossess 2 aims to deliver a next-generation horror experience. Designed to push the limits of atmosphere and fear, the game strives to be one of the most terrifying horror experiences available on the internet.
